objects.basis_note: Spa precinct (Angus's layout, 15 Sep 2026; the Fable build of 16 Sep 2026), asset origin J. Placed so the precinct's drive line lies on the surveyed drive past the church, measured from load_hardstanding_source's rings between Y -150 and -60 (fit x = 0.344*y - 67.277, heading 71.0 deg, so rot -18.98). The drive is a registered carriageway now (road.spa-drive-strip in roads.json, 4.5 m estate-drive): its centreline lies 11.0 m west of J under this transform. The precinct's six element GLBs (wings, hall, garden, pool, courts, roads) carry the identical transform: they are one plan split by element, origin J. J at (-98.58, -124.83); the surveyed church centroid (-90.6, -123.2) falls under the asset's hall, 4.9 m from the hall centroid, and the drive-to-hall offset is 21.5 m against the survey's 17.7 m (the brief's hall-centroid anchor and its drive proof cannot both hold; the drive is aligned and the offset is reported). Ground is the DTM at J.
objects.name: New spa building (~1,690 m2)
